submission.justification:
Absorber-F1 at 6mm plate thickness is recommended based on superior energy resolution performance across systematic optimization studies.

ENERGY RESOLUTION OPTIMIZATION:
Through comprehensive simulations (100,000 events each) across the full 2-10mm thickness range, Absorber-F1 at 6mm achieves the best energy resolution of 3.119% at 100 GeV. This represents:
- 24% better performance than Absorber-F2 at optimal thickness (3.875%)
- 61% better performance than Absorber-F3 at optimal thickness (5.034%)
- Clear optimum at 6mm, with degradation at both thinner and thicker plates

THICKNESS OPTIMIZATION:
The 6mm thickness represents the optimal balance between shower sampling and granularity:
- Thinner plates (2-4mm): insufficient sampling, lateral leakage
- Thicker plates (8-10mm): excessive shower spreading, reduced effective granularity
- All materials tested show similar optimal thickness around 6mm

CRITICAL CAVEAT - DOSE RATE VALIDATION REQUIRED:
The hard requirement for residual dose rate (≤20 µSv/h at 1m after one week cooldown) could not be verified from available project documents. This radiation safety constraint is MANDATORY for hands-on maintenance and could potentially override energy resolution considerations. Before final procurement, dose rate compliance MUST be verified through:
- Activation calculations for F1 material composition
- Radiation transport simulations
- Consultation with radiation safety team

If F1 fails dose rate requirements, Absorber-F2 at 6mm (3.875% resolution) is the recommended backup option.
